title.narrative: EU Support to Housing for Internally Displaced People in Zhytomyr

description.narrative:
Overall objectives:

The over objective of the Action is to contribute to inclusive social recovery and stabilisation in Ukraine.

Specific objectives:

1.    Increase access to social housing services for IDPs in Zhytomyr;

2.    Improve the well-being of IDPs in Zhytomyr;

3.    Increase the energy efficiency in the housing sector in Zhytomyr and reduced number of CO2 emissions;

4.    Increase employment in Zhytomyr.

The expected results of the Action are as follows:

-       Construction of seven multi-floored residential buildings for IDPs which lost their housing;
